items.question: Why is the Raudraraudreśvarī form held as desired by the best gurus?

The best gurus therefore desire this form.
items.inference: Because Raudraraudreśvarī has manifested in this way, the best gurus regard her as the desired form.
items.plain_english: The Raudraraudreśvarī who came forth is therefore desired by the best gurus.
